versions.content: On reception of a request for UDS Service 0x11 with the sub functions other than enableRapidPowerShutDown (0x04) or disableRapidPowerShut- Down (0x05), the Dcm module shall trigger the mode switch of ModeDeclarationGroup- Prototype DcmEcuReset equal to the received resetType. After the mode switch is requested the Dcm shall trigger the start of the positive response message transmis- sion. Sub function hardReset (0x01) to HARD Sub function keyOffOnReset (0x02) to KEYONOFF Sub function softReset (0x03) to SOFT
